candidates.title: Top DevOps Evangelist
candidates.description: Named Top DevOps Evangelist in the DevOps Dozen 2023 Community Awards (announced Jan 2024), the annual DevOps community awards run by Techstrong Group / DevOps.com.
candidates.citation: "We have followed Fatima at GitLab for several years. She specializes in CI/CD, community building, and evangelizing AI-powered workflows. Her passion for open source and building more inclusive tech communities makes her a standout and an extremely worthy winner." — Alan Shimel, Techstrong Group Founder & CEO
candidates.curator_note: Live-fetched: devopsdozen.com winners page contains the Alan Shimel citation verbatim plus 'Fatima Sarah Khalid – ... Developer Evangelist at GitLab'. devops.com honorees page independently lists '6. Top DevOps Evangelist: Fatima Sarah Khalid, Developer Evangelist at GitLab'. content-db already has this row with evidence_url=devops.com; recommend adding the devopsdozen.com primary URL + the full citation. Note the year vs issue-date wording: it is the '2023' award, announced Jan 2024. content-db lists year:2023 which is correct.

candidates.title: Google Open Source Peer Bonus
candidates.description: Recipient of a Google Open Source Peer Bonus in the 2020 Q1 cycle, which Google devoted to women in open source around International Women's Day 2020. Awarded for contributions to open source (Drupal project).
candidates.curator_note: FIXES A NULL: content-db currently has this award with evidence_url:null. The Google Open Source Blog post's raw HTML contains 'Fatima Sarah Khalid' in the winners list (confirmed via curl grep; the readability extractor drops the winners table, so a browser/raw-HTML check is how Soren should re-confirm). Page text confirms this cycle was the IWD-2020 women-in-open-source cycle, 56 winners / 17 countries. Recommend backfilling this evidence_url into content-db.

candidates.title: Rising Star — Leadership Excellence Award
candidates.organization: Women in Communications and Technology (WCT) Canada
candidates.description: Received the Women in Communications and Technology (WCT) Canada Rising Star, one of WCT's annual Leadership Excellence Awards, presented at the WCT gala in Ottawa on 16 Apr 2018. The Rising Star LEA recognizes a young person whose talent and leadership are evident early in their career. Awarded while at Digital Echidna (London, Ontario).
candidates.citation: The Rising Star Leadership Excellence Award "is presented to a young person whose talent and leadership abilities are evident early in their career."
candidates.curator_note: UPGRADE: content-db currently cites only the CBC press URL for this award. The awarding org's OWN page (wct-fct.com) is a stronger primary source — its Wayback snapshot lists 'Rising Star, Fatima Khalid, Developer, Digital Echidna' among the LEA recipients (live page is JS-gated; Wayback renders the names, confirmed via grep). Also found: a YouTube acceptance-speech video (Apr 16, 2018 Ottawa) and the Digital Echidna employer announcement blog (both live). The full award name is 'Leadership Excellence Award — Rising Star'; content-db's short title is fine but the LEA framing is more accurate. Ceremony date 16 Apr 2018 is per the YouTube description; the *announcement* was 13 Mar 2018 (CBC + echidna blog).
